review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Responsibilities • Design, set up, and configure networks for commercial AV and automation projects, including VLANs and network segmentation • Configure network devices (switches, routers, access points, AV and control devices) with static IP addressing • Set up and maintain VPN connections for remote access and support • Read and interpret connectivity drawings and system schematics • Understand AV signal flow (HDMI, HDBaseT, Dante/AV-over-IP, audio and control signals) and troubleshoot connectivity issues • Follow up with AutoCAD engineers on drawings, revisions, and design requirements • Provide IT support and troubleshooting for installed systems • Track project progress, follow up on project status, and update the CRM accordingly • Coordinate with installers, engineers, and clients to keep projects on schedule
